subject: SIG: RBAC delegation mapping & evidence request
messages:
From: Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@globalsec.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: GlobalSec Audit <audit@globalsec.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: SIG: RBAC delegation mapping & evidence request

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking this. As part of GlobalSec's SIG review we need to confirm your access control posture for the product environment and management plane. Can you provide the following artifacts/evidence items by EOD 11/17?

- A role-to-permission matrix for all production roles (including delegated admin roles and service accounts)
- SCIM provisioning mapping (group -> role) and an example provisioning log where a user was added and removed
- SSO/SAML configuration summary (IdP metadata, assertion mapping) and screenshots of Admin Console settings
- MFA enforcement proof (policy screenshot + one example login event showing MFA triggered)
- Short explanation of your least-privilege model and how RBAC is enforced for automation/service accounts

If you can also call out any known exceptions and remediation timelines that helps the review team. We may ask a few follow-ups after we review.

Attachments: none from our side for this request.

Appreciate it — goal is to close the SIG by 11/24.

Best,
Audrey Chen
Senior Security Analyst
GlobalSec
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@globalsec.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, GlobalSec Audit <audit@globalsec.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG: RBAC delegation mapping & evidence request

Hi Audrey — thanks for the clear list. We're on it.

Deliverables we'll provide by EOD 11/17:
- Role-permission matrix (Excel): includes named roles, permission scopes, and notes on delegated admin roles — file: sig_rbac_matrix_v1.xlsx (attached).
- SCIM mapping and one provisioning log (CSV export) — service_account_inventory.csv (attached) and a short log excerpt.
- SSO/SAML summary + admin console screenshots — sso_flow_diagram.png (attached) and URL to admin screenshots in Drive.
- MFA enforcement evidence: policy snapshot + one login event — mfa_policy_snapshot.pdf (attached).
- A brief write-up describing our least-privilege approach and exceptions (inline below).

Quick notes on least-privilege: we assign roles at the group level via SCIM groups mapped to platform roles. Service accounts are scoped to a minimal set of APIs and are subject to token rotation and short lifespans. Delegated admin roles are limited to tenant-level support functions and require both an approval ticket in Jira and justification in the role description.

If you need screenshots in a specific format or more granular event logs (SIEM export), tell us and we'll add them.

Action items on our side: Karthik will validate the service account inventory and confirm there are no unmanaged keys; Marissa will capture the admin console screenshots and the provisioning log excerpt.

I'll send a consolidated package later this week.

Thanks,
Sofia
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2027 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG: RBAC delegation mapping & evidence request

Sofia — quick internal notes before we finalize attachments.

- The current RBAC matrix (v1) doesn't explicitly call out 'delegated support admins' created for our managed customers; I'll add a column for scope (global | tenant | app).
- Service accounts: I'll export the list of non-human credentials and include the last-used timestamp. We should redact secrets but include key IDs.
- MFA: we enforce MFA for interactive accounts via IdP policy; however, machine-to-machine flows use client certificates or short-lived tokens. Add a note explaining that and include the policy link (internal).

Marissa — can you pull the provisioning audit log for 2027-10-20 to 2027-11-10 and include one example (user join -> role assignment) with timestamps? That should satisfy their request for an example.

I'll attach service_account_inventory.csv in the package and update the RBAC spreadsheet.

-Karthik
Engineering Manager, Platform
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@globalsec.com>, GlobalSec Audit <audit@globalsec.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@clientco.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Nov 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: SIG: RBAC delegation mapping & evidence request — package delivered

Audrey / Audit team — attaching the requested artifacts for the SIG review. Please find the package below and a brief summary of contents/next steps.

Attachments (zipped):
- sig_rbac_matrix_v1.xlsx (role -> permission -> scope; delegated admin rows flagged)
- service_account_inventory.csv (non-human credentials; last-used timestamp; key IDs redacted)
- sso_flow_diagram.png (IdP -> SP assertion mapping + authn flow)
- mfa_policy_snapshot.pdf (IdP policy screenshot showing enforcement rules)

Drive links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1Gx-example-link-RBAC (admin screenshots and raw export files)

Summary of items to note:
- Delegated admin roles are tenant-scoped and require a Jira approval; these are documented in the RBAC matrix under the "delegation_scope" column.
- SCIM group mapping: groups map to platform roles; provisioning logs included show a sample add/remove event (2027-10-27T14:03:12Z).
- MFA enforcement: interactive users enforced through IdP; machine/service accounts authenticated via short-lived tokens. We included one login event showing MFA challenge.

Open items we flagged internally (will be resolved by 12/03):
1) Rotate a small set of long-lived service keys flagged in our inventory (we will rotate and upload proof).
2) Add automation to push provisioning logs to the SIEM in near-real-time (design in progress).

If you'd like to discuss any item live, I'm available 11/18 after 10:00 PT — propose a 30-min slot to walk through the RBAC matrix and provisioning log.

Thanks — looking forward to your confirmatory review.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
